privacy.scope: Changed/new prospective repository files, including sanitized fixture databases and execution logs.
privacy.method: Static candidate-secret-prefix scan; matching values are never printed. Generated fixtures and records were also reviewed for owner data.
privacy.limitations: Not a general proof of absence of arbitrary private information. Private Claude configuration, owner histories and recording pixels were not accessed.

diffCheck.disposition: Preserve canonical ts-rs output. Its generated documentation line breaks already contain trailing spaces in accepted source; schema/export checks compare the exact generated bytes.
